ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: harvest push
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Everyone to the fields to sow, tend and harvest from first light to last. Crops come in faster and fuller, and backs ache. Growers enjoy it; the lazy and undergrounders hate it.

effects.li: Plant work is 30% faster and harvests yield 5% more.
Growers like it; the lazy and undergrounders hate it.

plain.li: If we don't get the corn in this week, we'll be eating bark by midwinter.

cheerful.li: Dirt under my fingernails all week. My favorite kind of week!

cold.li: Yield per day up a third. Correct priority.

plain.li: I'll be picking corn in my dreams.

blunt.li: My back's done. Find someone younger.

gloomy.li: Bent double for days, and the blight will come anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: building season
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Every spare hand goes to walls, floors and tunnels. Construction and mining go much faster, and most colonists go to bed sore and covered in dust.

effects.li: Construction is 30% faster and mining 20% faster.
Builders, miners and the industrious like it; the lazy hate it.

plain.li: Give me a week and you won't recognize the place.

cheerful.li: A whole new wing! Someone hand me a hammer.

cold.li: Two finished rooms are worth more than five half-built ones.

plain.li: I've had rock dust in my teeth for three days straight.

warm.li: I'll help. I just wish someone would build a bath first.

blunt.li: I've laid enough stone this year.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: best behavior
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Everyone is on their best behavior: polite to traders, patient with prisoners, friendly to visitors. Trading, recruiting and talking people around all go better. The abrasive find it exhausting.

effects.li: Negotiation ability and social impact up 25%: better recruiting, taming and diplomacy.
The kind and the sociable like it; the abrasive hate it.

plain.li: Be polite to the traders. We need better prices than we got last time.

warm.li: It's nice, everyone being nice. Can we keep it?

cold.li: Courtesy is a negotiating tool. Use it.

blunt.li: If I have to say "please" one more time, I'll bite someone.

plain.li: My face hurts from all the smiling.

gloomy.li: Smiling at strangers all day. I'm worn out by noon.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: days of mourning
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: All work slows by 30% so the colony can grieve together. Grief fades faster for those who lost someone, and they are less likely to break. Only possible while someone is grieving.

effects.li: Grief fades much faster, and mental breaks are less likely.
The grieving are grateful; psychopaths and the industrious find it a waste.

plain.li: We owe them this much. A few days of quiet.

warm.li: Come sit with me. Tell me something about them.

gloomy.li: We should do this more. We lose people often enough.

cold.li: Two days of lost work won't bring anyone back.

plain.li: I grieve better with a shovel in my hand.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: on guard
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Weapons within reach, eyes on the horizon, sleep in shifts. Everyone fights a little better and tires faster. The bloodthirsty like it; the nervous, the volatile and wimps hate it.

effects.li: Better aim and melee: shooting accuracy and hit chance go up.
The bloodthirsty like it; the nervous and wimps hate it.

plain.li: Let them come. We'll see them first.

blunt.li: Finally. I've been sleeping with a knife anyway.

cold.li: A raid we see coming costs us less.

plain.li: Every snapped twig sounds like a raid now.

gloomy.li: Sitting up all night waiting for raiders. I don't sleep much anyway.

warm.li: Can we at least take turns being scared?

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: clean sweep
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Scrub everything: floors, tables, bedding, the hospital twice. Cleaning goes much faster, wounds are tended more carefully, and bodies fight off illness better. Most colonists dislike it, but doctors like it.

effects.li: Wounds are tended better and immunity builds faster.
Doctors like it; the lazy hate it.

plain.li: About time. The hospital floor was a disgrace.

cold.li: Fewer infections means fewer graves to dig.

plain.li: I've scrubbed the kitchen floor three times today.

blunt.li: I've lived with dirt all my life. I'm fine.

cheerful.li: I'm making it a game. Whoever finds the most mud wins!

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: days of rest
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Shorter days, longer evenings, and nobody woken early. Everyone works 10% slower, and strain drains about twice as fast. The worn out and the lazy are glad of it; the industrious would rather work. Only with feelings and strain switched on.

effects.li: Strain drains about twice as fast while it holds.
Most colonists are glad of it, the lazy most of all; the industrious would rather work.

plain.li: Three days. That's all I'm asking for. Three days where nobody needs anything from me.

warm.li: Look at everyone. We're running on fumes. Let's stop for a bit.

gloomy.li: If we don't rest now, we'll be resting in the graveyard.

cold.li: Tired hands make mistakes. A short rest costs less than a long recovery.

plain.li: The fields won't tend themselves while we nap.

cheerful.li: Rest? I've been looking forward to finishing the north wall!
